title: On some results of Korobov and Larcher and Zaremba's conjecture
summary: We prove, in particular, the well--known Zaremba conjecture from the theory of continued fractions for any prime denominator. More precisely, we show, firstly, that under some mild conditions, for any sufficiently large $q$, there exists $a$ coprime to $q$ such that all partial quotients of $a/q$ are bounded by $O(\sqrt{\log q})$, and, moreover we find asymptotically tight lower bound for the number of such $a$.
